theater: 阿姆河下游古城玉龍傑赤

battle.name: 玉龍傑赤之戰
battle.theater: 阿姆河下游古城玉龍傑赤
battle.brief: 蒙古第一次西征期間，朮赤與察合台於一二二〇年夏圍困花剌子模舊都玉龍傑赤，康里守軍約三萬憑土坯城牆與壕溝抵抗，圍城歷時六個多月。配重投石車壓制城頭、拆毀城樓而未能獨力破城，最後由窩闊台渡阿姆河迂迴夾擊，一二二一年初城破。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 玉龍傑赤之戰是1219至1221年蒙古第一次西征中的一場攻城戰，戰場在阿姆河下游、花剌子模沙朝的舊都玉龍傑赤，即今土庫曼斯坦與烏茲別克斯坦交界的古烏爾根奇。蒙古一方是大蒙古國的西征軍：成吉思汗分兵數路之後，指派長子朮赤與次子察合台各領一翼，向阿姆河兩岸推進，專職的攻城隊伍由漢人、契丹與回回工匠組成，隨軍攜帶配重投石車等器械，萬戶與千戶各領所部，號令由成吉思汗與兩子直接下達。花剌子模一方，此時蘇丹摩訶末已於1220年病逝，帝國在形式上解體，烏爾根奇、訛答剌等城各由總督與禁軍自行防守，兵權互不統屬，蘇丹的中央兵權既不能干預守城，也無法就近解圍。玉龍傑赤的守軍以康里部落的突厥騎兵為主（漢籍另稱花剌子模契丹或吉爾伽斯人），輔以城內徵召的步兵與隨軍工匠，另有守城用的投石砲與弩砲。康里人在花剌子模軍中一向是騎兵主力，騎射嫻熟，卻沒有能與蒙古大軍抗衡的攻城器械，也沒有統一號令的指揮中心。
countriesEn: The Battle of Yulong Jiechi was a siege fought during the Mongol campaign against Khwarazm between 1219 and 1221, at the old capital of the Khwarazmshahs, Yulong Jiechi, on the lower Amu Darya, at what is now the site of Konye Urgench on the border between Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan. On the Mongol side stood the western expedition of the Great Mongol Empire: after splitting his army into several columns, Genghis Khan assigned his first and third sons, Jochi and Chagatai, to drive forward on either side of the river, while a specialist siege corps of Han Chinese, Khitan and Huihui technicians marched with the column and dragged counterweight trebuchets and other engines behind them, the myriad and the thousand-strong units each under its own head, and the orders running straight from the khan and his two sons. On the Khwarazmian side the empire had already come apart in form: the shah Ala al-Din Muhammad II died in 1220, each city such as Urgench and Otrar was to defend itself under its own governor and its own guard, the commands were not subordinate to one another, and the central authority of the shah could neither direct the defence nor bring relief. The garrison of Yulong Jiechi was made up mainly of Turkic horse from the Kangli tribes (elsewhere in the Chinese records called the Khwarazmian Qipchaq or Jirqis people), with foot levied from the town and its craftsmen, backed by stone-throwers and bolt-throwers set up on the walls. The Kangli had always been the cavalry backbone of the Khwarazmian army, skilled riders, but they had no siege engines capable of matching the Mongols and no command centre able to hold them to a single plan.
people: 蒙古方面的關鍵人物是成吉思汗鐵木真與他的幾個兒子。朮赤領北方之軍，本部在阿姆河以北負責警戒，向玉龍傑赤進攻時他主張速戰速決；察合台領左翼，攻城的前鋒由他的部眾擔當，習慣以本部營地與所得為重，兩人在圍城期間因分工事功與部眾歸屬屢起爭執，兵臨城下而不能合力，圍攻因此一拖再拖。成吉思汗得知後，另遣傑別與速不台率兵赴援；真正完成破城的是第三子窩闊台，他率部自阿姆河上游渡河，從城西方向迂迴，與正面形成夾擊。守城方面的記載較為零碎：蒙古秘史與元史多以康里人概稱守軍，首領姓名各書不一，難以指實。花剌子模方面，蘇丹摩訶末在布哈拉、撒馬爾罕陷落後退往呼羅珊，1220年病逝於裏海邊緣；其長子札蘭丁（漢籍亦稱哲烈亦）正是在玉龍傑赤被圍之際自北方逃出，轉入波斯境內，其後在帕爾萬打敗過蒙古先鋒，最終在印度河畔覆滅。蒙古軍中的攻城工匠隊伍另有其人，這批人跟隨成吉思汗征西夏時已熟悉砲與穴地之法，是攻城器械真正落到實處的關鍵。
peopleEn: The decisive figures on the Mongol side were Genghis Khan himself and his sons. Jochi commanded the northern force, keeping watch north of the Amu Darya, and at Yulong Jiechi pressed for a quick decision; Chagatai commanded the left wing, his own men forming the assault echelon, and he was used to putting his own camp and his own gains first, so the two quarrelled repeatedly during the siege over the division of credit and the allegiance of the troops, and with the armies lying before the city they could not act together, which is why the investment dragged on. Genghis Khan, on learning of the deadlock, sent Jebe and Subutai with a relieving force, and it was his third son Ogedei who actually brought the city down, crossing the Amu Darya higher up and turning in from the west so as to fall between the defenders and the north. The account of the defenders is thinner: the Secret History of the Mongols and the Yuan shi speak generally of Kangli men, and the name of their commander is given differently from book to book and cannot be securely identified. On the Khwarazmian side the shah Ala al-Din Muhammad II had withdrawn to Khorasan after the fall of Bukhara and Samarqand and died in 1220 on the edge of the Caspian; his eldest son Jalal al-Din escaped from the north while Yulong Jiechi was still invested, made his way into Persia, defeated a Mongol vanguard at Parwan, and was finally destroyed on the Indus. The engineers of the Mongol train were a further element: men who had followed Genghis Khan against Western Xia already knew stone-throwing engines and sapping, and they were the reason the siege engines actually worked.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是配重投石車，即以長臂與配重把石彈甩出的拋射機，12世紀以來在歐洲與伊斯蘭世界都已使用，義大利與地中海沿岸最為流行；蒙古軍所用的這類砲則出自被征服的華夏與回回工匠之手，本質是東西技術的合流。攻城器械的體系大致可分三層：一是遠程投射的配重投石車與弩砲，用以打擊城樓、塔樓與牆段，壓制城頭的射擊陣位；二是接近城牆的雲梯、木製攻城架與穴地，即在牆根挖地道、以木架與填土築成斜坡；三是封鎖用的壕溝、拒馬與繩索，用以截斷守軍出城反衝。守城的花剌子模軍並非沒有器械，牆上設有弩砲與回回砲，城外有壕溝與人工運渠，城門內還備有擋門的障礙與陷坑。蒙古軍的攻城器材多就地徵用：木料取自城郊林地，繩索與石彈由隨軍工匠與徵集的丁夫供應，攻城之後把鐵匠、木匠與技術人員編入軍籍，帶往下一座城。值得注意的是，配重投石車在玉龍傑赤並沒有單獨完成破城：砲火能拆毀城樓、削薄城頭火力，卻無法瓦解一座守軍頑強、壕溝完整、糧水未斷的城；真正決定戰局的是砲火、穴地與迂迴騎兵的配合。蒙古騎兵裝備仍以複合反曲角弓為核心，配骨鏃與札甲，馬匹同時是乘騎與載具。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the counterweight trebuchet, the engine that hurls a stone from the end of a long arm weighted at the short end. It had been in use in Europe and in the Islamic world since the twelfth century and was commonest around Italy and the Mediterranean; the versions the Mongols used were the work of Han Chinese and Huihui technicians taken into service after conquest, so that the machine in effect marries Eastern and Western practice. The siege train falls into three layers. First, stand-off engines: counterweight trebuchets and bolt-throwers, used against towers, bastions and stretches of wall to suppress the firing positions on the parapet. Second, means of approach: scaling ladders, timber siege frames and sapping, that is, digging under the wall and building a ramp of timber and fill. Third, blockade: ditches, abatis and rope, to cut off the sorties of the defenders. The Khwarazmian defenders were not without equipment of their own: bolt-throwers and Muslim-style stone-throwers stood on the walls, a moat and man-made canals ran outside the city, and the gates were blocked with barriers and pits. The Mongols took most of their materials on the spot: timber from the woods outside the city, rope and shot supplied by the engineers and the labour levy, and after each siege the smiths, carpenters and technicians were enrolled into the army and marched on to the next city. What matters is that the trebuchet did not take Yulong Jiechi by itself: its fire could pull down towers and thin the defenders on the wall, but it could not break a city whose garrison held firm, whose ditch was intact and whose water and grain had not failed; what decided the battle was the combination of artillery, sapping and turning cavalry. The Mongol rider's own kit remained centred on the composite recurved bow, with bone arrowheads and lamellar armour, and the horse served at once as mount and pack animal.
tactics: 蒙古圍城的套路在玉龍傑赤看得很清楚。軍隊抵城後先四面合圍，朮赤與察合台各負責一面，兩面之間以游騎巡邏聯絡，杜絕守軍出城反衝或送信求援；其後不急於強攻，而是先立遠程投射陣位，把配重投石車架在城外高處或土築台基上，先打城樓、射孔與城頭的巡邏隊，迫守軍把掩體移到牆根，同時在城郊挖掘壕溝、斷其樵採與水源，並控制通往城內的運渠，令城內的物資調度日益吃力。守軍並非全無反制：他們利用土坯城牆的厚實，在牆下鑿地道試圖塌陷牆基，蒙古軍則在牆外填塞壕溝、堆土築壘，把接近的通道收窄。圍城橫跨嚴冬，阿姆河結冰可行人馬渡越，蒙古軍也得以在冰面過河，把援軍與糧草運到西岸；草料不足與寒冷則使馬匹掉膘，遠征的消耗在這個冬天格外明顯。僵局的破解靠的是迂迴：窩闊台率部自上游渡過阿姆河，繞到城的西側進攻，與朮赤、察合台的正面壓力合為一體，守軍的注意力分散，城市的門戶才被打開。蒙古軍慣用的驅趕與夜襲手法在圍城後期亦有用：白日以矢石壓制，入夜派小隊逼近城根，試圖引出守軍出城追擊，再在預設地點合圍。
tacticsEn: The Mongol method of investing a city is plainly visible at Yulong Jiechi. On arrival the army closed in on all four sides, Jochi taking one sector and Chagatai another, with patrols riding between the two to stop any sortie or any message getting out to ask for help. There was no hurry to assault. The engines were set up first, the counterweight trebuchets mounted outside the walls on high ground or on earthen platforms, firing at towers, arrow slits and the guards walking the parapet, forcing the defenders down behind the wall, while the besiegers dug their ditches, cut the firewood and the water supply and took hold of the canals that fed the city, so that the movement of supplies inside the walls grew harder with every week. The defenders were not without answers: the thickness of the unbaked-brick wall let them work a tunnel under the foundations in the hope of bringing the wall down, and the Mongols replied by filling the ditches and piling earth and brushwood against the wall to narrow every approach. The siege ran through the hard winter; the Amu Darya froze over and could be crossed on foot and horseback, and the Mongols used the ice to bring reinforcements and fodder across to the western bank, while the shortage of grass and the cold stripped the horses of their fat and the wastage of the long campaign showed plainly in that winter. The deadlock was broken by a turning movement: Ogedei crossed the Amu Darya higher up, swung round to the west of the city and attacked from there, so that the pressure from the front kept up by Jochi and Chagatai and the attack from the rear fell on the same distracted garrison, and only then were the gates of the city opened. The Mongol habit of harrying the enemy and attacking by night was useful in the closing weeks: by day the walls were kept down with arrow and stone, and by night small parties crept to the foot of the wall to draw the defenders out, and were closed on at a place chosen in advance.
data: 可確認的數字有限，但有幾項相當一致。圍城始於1220年夏，漢籍記為六個多月，《集史》等波斯方面的記載則記成七個月，兩說並存。城破的時點，漢籍系史料多落在1221年正月至二月之間，波斯方面記在1221年初，實際應在1220年夏末圍起、跨過一個冬天之後。守軍兵力，《集史》等波斯與中亞方面的記載多寫成三萬，現代研究則認為實際人數當低於此數；漢籍的戰果統計又記城破時守軍被消滅約九萬，方向可信而絕對值應當打折看待。成吉思汗在得知朮赤與察合台相持不下後，遣傑別與速不台率約二萬人赴援，此數出自同期與後出的波斯史家，應視為約數。西征大軍的總數說法分歧，估計在十萬上下，其中負責河中與呼羅珊作戰的各路兵力在數萬騎之譜。地理上，撒馬爾罕至玉龍傑赤直線距離約六百公里，糧草、攻城木料與石彈需要從布哈拉與撒馬爾罕方向沿河谷北運，阿姆河該段河面寬約數百公尺，冬季結冰時可以人馬與車輛通過。城址方面的可以確定的是：古城的城牆以土坯築成，1221年城破之後原址被徹底破壞，直到1231年才在原城南方重建新城，此後城市重心轉往北面的希瓦。
dataEn: The firm figures are few, but several are consistent across the sources. The siege was laid in the summer of 1220; the Chinese records give a little over six months, while the Jami al-Tawarikh and the other Persian accounts give seven, and both readings can stand. The date of the fall falls in the first or second month of 1221 in the Chinese series and in early 1221 in the Persian, so the investment began in late summer 1220 and ran through one winter. For the strength of the garrison the Jami al-Tawarikh and the other Persian and Central Asian accounts give thirty thousand, which modern work regards as an overstatement of what was really there; the Chinese battle returns give the destruction of about ninety thousand of the defenders, and the direction of that figure is credible while its absolute value should be discounted. When Genghis Khan learned that Jochi and Chagatai were at loggerheads he sent Jebe and Subutai with about twenty thousand men to the relief; the figure comes from the Persian chroniclers of the period and of the decades after, and should be taken as approximate. The size of the whole expedition is given inconsistently and is estimated at around a hundred thousand, of whom the columns that fought in Transoxiana and Khorasan were some tens of thousands of riders. In distance, Samarqand lies about six hundred kilometres from Yulong Jiechi in a straight line, and grain, timber and shot had to be carried north from the Bukhara and Samarqand directions along the valley; the Amu Darya at this point is some several hundred metres wide and in winter can be crossed on the ice by men, horses and carts. On the site itself one thing is certain: the walls of the old city were built of unbaked brick, and after the city fell in 1221 the site was broken up completely, remaining waste ground for twenty years until a new town was raised south of the old walls in 1231, after which the centre of the city shifted north towards Khiva.
cause: 玉龍傑赤之戰是蒙古第一次西征的產物，遠因可以上溯到1219年開戰的理由。其一是商旅與使者被殺：蒙古商隊在花剌子模境內被課重稅、扣貨甚至殺害，後續使團也被處決，談判斷絕。深一層是戰略上的：花剌子模扼守中亞商道，又站在西夏背後，曾允許西夏借道攻擊蒙古，蒙古完成草原統一、滅西夏在即，與花剌子模的碰撞無可避免。蘇丹的處置則是戰爭的技術原因：他分兵固守二十餘座城，把援軍、信息與指揮權一起拆散，每城各自為戰，這使蒙古軍得以各個擊破。落到本場戰役，成吉思汗分兵之後要肅清阿姆河下游的花剌子模據點，玉龍傑赤是花剌子模的舊都與絲路樞紐，控扼阿姆河南北的交通，守軍又格外頑強；再加上朮赤與察合台之間的指揮權之爭，一場本可速決的攻城戰變成了漫長的消耗。
causeEn: The Battle of Yulong Jiechi was a product of the first Mongol western campaign, and its remote reasons go back to the outbreak of war in 1219. The first was the killing of merchants and envoys: Mongol caravans were heavily taxed in Khwarazmian territory, their goods detained and their people killed, and a later embassy was executed, so that negotiation came to an end. One level deeper lies the strategic motive: Khwarazm stood on the throat of the Central Asian caravan roads and behind Western Xia, and had given the Xia leave to cross its territory and attack the Mongols from the rear; the Mongols had united the steppe, the conquest of Western Xia was close at hand, and collision with Khwarazm was unavoidable. The shah's own handling of the situation was the technical cause of the disaster: he split his forces to hold more than twenty cities, scattering the relief armies, the intelligence and the command with them, so that each city fought alone and the Mongols could take them one at a time. As for this particular siege, once the army was split Genghis Khan needed to clear the Khwarazmian strongholds along the lower Amu Darya; Yulong Jiechi was the old capital of Khwarazm and a hinge of the silk road, commanding the crossings of the Amu Darya, and its garrison was unusually stubborn. Add the quarrel between Jochi and Chagatai over who should command, and a siege that should have been decided quickly turned into a long grinding contest.
impact: 這一場圍城留下的東西，遠比城本身更重要。技術上，蒙古把華夏與回回的攻城技術帶進中亞，配重投石車、弩砲、穴地與攻城架成為大軍中常設的特種兵種，隨後在波斯、俄羅斯與歐洲的攻城戰中反覆使用；攻下玉龍傑赤也意味著蒙古第一次拿下伊斯蘭世界的一座大城市，其攻城方法自此為歐洲所知。政治上，花剌子模西部就此瓦解，蒙古控制了阿姆河渡口與河中通往波斯的商道，阿姆河以北的草原與河中的灌溉綠洲連成一片，後來的伊兒汗國即建基於此。城市與經濟上，烏爾根奇被拆毀，柯瓦茲姆綠洲的城市網與灌溉體系遭到系統性破壞，此後數百年都是低開發的鹽鹼地，直到近代才重新整治。蒙古帝國自身的裂痕也在此加深：朮赤與察合台的爭執讓成吉思汗認定四子之間無法統合，遂在破城之後正式指定窩闊台為汗位繼承人，朮赤不滿而北去，此後蒙古帝國分家，拔都系建立金帳汗國。對西方而言，1222年自匈牙利返回的多明我會修士寫下的書信描述東方大王的土地與軍隊，歐洲由此把蒙古視為需要認真對付的遠方君主。
impactEn: What this siege left behind mattered far more than the city itself. In technical terms the Mongols carried Chinese and Huihui siegecraft into Central Asia, and the counterweight trebuchet, the bolt-thrower, the sap and the timber siege frame became standing specialist arms of the army, used again and again in the sieges of Persia, of Rus and of Europe; the taking of Yulong Jiechi was also the first time the Mongols had seized a great city of the Islamic world, and from then on their methods of siege were known in Europe. Politically the west of Khwarazm came apart, the Mongols took the crossings of the Amu Darya and the caravan road that led from Transoxiana into Persia, and the pastures north of the river were joined to the irrigated oases of the river, a foundation on which the later Ilkhanate was built. Economically the town of Urgench was dismantled and the urban network and irrigation system of the Khorezm oasis were broken up systematically, leaving that land a poorly developed saline waste for several hundred years until it was reclaimed in modern times. The cracks inside the Mongol empire deepened here as well: the quarrel between Jochi and Chagatai convinced Genghis Khan that his four sons could not be held together, and after the fall of the city he formally named Ogedei as his successor; Jochi was dissatisfied and withdrew to the north, and from this the division of the empire into separate khanates followed, with Batu's line founding the Golden Horde. For the West, the letter written in 1222 by the Dominican friar returning from Hungary described the lands and the armies of the great king of the east, and Europe began to take the Mongols seriously as a distant power that had to be reckoned with.
result: 結果是蒙古軍在1221年初攻破玉龍傑赤。窩闊台部自西岸迂迴進逼，正面又有配重投石車與穴地配合，城中守軍的抵抗終於瓦解，蒙古軍入城之後把城牆與屋舍盡行拆毀，原址在往後二十年一直是廢墟，直到1231年才在原城南方重建新城。城破之後，朮赤與察合台的爭執並未收斂，圍城期間的怨望延續到成吉思汗的晚年，也延續到帝國的分裂。花剌子模的西部至此再無可恃：蘇丹已死於裏海邊緣，札蘭丁帶著殘部退往波斯與印度方向，一二二一年在印度河畔被蒙古主力擊潰，此後花剌子模沙朝再無可能重建。從兵器史的角度看，這一戰說明配重投石車的極限：它能拆毀城樓、壓制城頭，卻不能單獨攻下一座守軍完整、壕溝未失的城；決定戰局的是攻城器械、騎兵迂迴、指揮統一與季節條件的同時到位，而蒙古人在此之後的攻城戰，仍沿用同一套組合。
resultEn: The result was that the Mongol army took Yulong Jiechi in early 1221. Ogedei's men had swung in from the western bank while the front was kept up by trebuchet fire and sapping, the resistance of the garrison broke down, and after the storm the walls and houses of the city were pulled down piece by piece; the site remained waste ground for twenty years, until a new town was built south of the old city in 1231. The quarrel between Jochi and Chagatai was not settled by the fall of the city: the resentment of the siege ran on into the last years of Genghis Khan's reign and into the division of the empire. The west of Khwarazm had nothing left to rely on; the shah was dead on the edge of the Caspian, Jalal al-Din was retreating with the remnants of his army towards Persia and India, and after he was beaten by the main Mongol force on the Indus in 1221 the Khwarazmshah's house could never be rebuilt. From the point of view of the history of weapons, the battle sets out the limits of the counterweight trebuchet: it can bring down a tower and silence a parapet, but it cannot take by itself a city whose garrison is unbroken and whose ditch has not been lost; what decided the issue was the presence together of siege engines, turning cavalry, a single command and the right season, and the Mongols went on using the same combination in every siege that followed.
